players.product: AI GPU cloud (liquid + air-cooled data centers; 5 GW secured power, target 150k GPUs)

quarterly_data.signal: IREN's 10-K segment revenue: AI Cloud $128.8M for fiscal year 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 (+685.6% YoY vs $16.4M). During the year IREN entered into agreements giving customers dedicated GPU computing capacity, accounted for as operating leases of specified GPU equipment and dedicated data center space (with IREN as lessor); the leases commence on customer acceptance and generally run approximately three to five years.

IREN's 10-K states that it acquires GPUs from NVIDIA under supply arrangements with NVIDIA. The Investment Rights relating to those supply arrangements are capitalized as part of the cost of the GPUs acquired from NVIDIA as the GPUs are received, and are accounted for separately from IREN's cloud services agreement with NVIDIA, under which NVIDIA is a customer of IREN.
